text: Add a private repository as a space by its git URL with a deploy key the server makes
description: Felix 2026-11-20: "add a repo by git URL, then generate a deploy key? That'd be awesome." On the start page, "Add it with a deploy key": the server makes an SSH key for the account (only the public half leaves the server), the person adds it on the repository with write access (link straight to GitHub's deploy-key page), and the server clones over SSH with it and pushes changes back. A repository without .bowman gets a new space, committed and pushed.

status.comment: Built and tested against local repositories (1aee99ba, remote-graph.test.ts). What remains needs Felix's GitHub account: (1) Start page → 'Add it with a deploy key' → paste the game repository's SSH URL (git@github.com:<owner>/<repo>.git). (2) Copy the public key, click 'Open the repository's deploy keys on GitHub', add it with 'Allow write access'. (3) Back in Aimparency, confirm: the space opens (a new .bowman is committed and pushed if the repo had none). (4) Edit one idea and check that the commit shows up on GitHub. If a step fails, the backend log line is enough for the next agent to fix it.
